1. (Currently Amended) A gas generator comprising: a composition containing an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent, and a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total composition; and a desiccant in __thermal__ operable communication with said composition.

2. (Currently Amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said desiccant is mixed into said composition at about 10-35 weight percent of the total composition, __wherein the total weight percentage of the desiccant, oxidizer, and fuel does not exceed 100 weight percent__.

3. (Currently Amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said desiccant is in vapor communication with, but physically separated from, said composition, and said desiccant is provided in amounts resulting in a mass differential of about -5.0 to 5.0% of the composition after heat aging at 107C for 400 hours, __wherein the desiccant aids in maintaining the thermal stability of the composition__.

4. (Currently Amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said composition contains an extrusion aid __selected from the group consisting of graphite, fumed silica, and mixtures thereof__ provided at about 0.1-10 weight percent of the total gas generant composition.

5. (Currently Amended) The gas generator of claim 4 wherein said extrusion aid is selected from graphite, fumed silica, and __a thermally stable processing aid__.

6. (Currently Amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said alkali metal chlorate is potassium chlorate, __and is present at a concentration of about 25-75 weight percent of the total composition__.

7. (Currently Amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said carboxylic acid is selected from tartaric acid and its isomers, succinic acid, glutamic acid, adipic acid, and mucic acid, and mixtures thereof, __wherein at least one of the selected carboxylic acids exhibits enhanced thermal stability__.

8. (Currently Amended) The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said carboxylic acid is DL-tartaric acid, __which contributes to the thermal stability of the gas generator composition__.

9. (Currently Amended) A gas generating system comprising: a gas generator comprising a composition, said composition containing an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent, and said composition further containing a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total gas generant composition; and a desiccant in __thermal__ operable communication with said composition.

10. (Currently Amended) The gas generating system of claim 9 wherein said desiccant is mixed into said composition at about 10-35 weight percent of the total composition, __wherein the total weight percentage of the desiccant, oxidizer, and fuel does not exceed 100 weight percent__.

11. (Currently Amended) The gas generating system of claim 9 wherein said desiccant is in vapor communication with, but physically separated from, said composition, __and enhances the thermal stability of the composition__.

12. (Currently Amended) The gas generating system of claim 9 wherein said system is a vehicle occupant protection system __utilizing the enhanced stability of the gas generator composition__.

13. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising: an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent; a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent; and a desiccant provided at about 5-35 weight-percent, __wherein the combination of these components is optimized for thermal stability__, said percentages stated by weight of the total gas generant composition.

14. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said carboxylic acid is selected from tartaric acid and its isomers, DL-tartaric acid, succinic acid, glutamic acid, adipic acid, and mucic acid, and mixtures thereof, __wherein at least one of the selected carboxylic acids exhibits enhanced thermal stability__.

15. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said alkali metal chlorate is potassium chlorate, __providing a favorable energetic performance characteristics__.

16. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is selected from activated calcium sulfate, silica, zeolite, clay, and calcium oxide, __wherein the selection is made to improve the thermal stability of the composition__.

17. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is zeolite, __which enhances the thermal stability of the composition__.

18. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is selected to provide a mass differential of about -5.0% to 5.0% after heat aging at 107C for 400 hours, __thereby contributing to the overall performance stability of the composition__.
